intro: Summarise a cultural work and back up an evaluation with a specific feature.

texto: A short review gives context without revealing unnecessary details, summarises the approach and supports an opinion with a feature: rhythm, acting, structure or image. **Jeg likte…, særlig fordi…** («I liked… especially because…») offers a justified evaluation. Contrast with **samtidig** («at the same time») or **likevel** («even so»).

frases.estudio: Stykket følger to søsken som rydder et gammelt verksted. Handlingen er enkel, men dialogen gir hver rollefigur en tydelig stemme. Scenografien bruker få gjenstander, og lysendringene viser hvordan tiden går. Noen scener er langsomme; likevel skaper pausene en rolig stemning. Jeg anbefaler stykket til dem som liker samtaler og små detaljer.
frases.alumno: The play follows two siblings who clear out an old workshop. The plot is simple, but the dialogue gives each character a clear voice. The set uses few objects, and changes of light show the passing of time. Some scenes are slow; even so, the pauses create a calm atmosphere. I recommend the play to those who enjoy conversations and small details.

pregunta.texto: Which feature shows the passing of time?

opciones.explicacion: The text says changes in light show the passing of time.
The text doesn't mention a narrator.

pregunta.texto: Write a five-sentence review of a cultural work you know. Summarise without spoilers and support an evaluation with an example.

textos: Filmen handler om en familie som flytter til en øy. Historien går rolig fram. Jeg likte lydene fra naturen, særlig i scenen ved brygga. Slutten er åpen. Jeg anbefaler filmen til dem som liker langsomme fortellinger.

piezas.explicacion: Model: concise summary, a specific feature and a nuanced recommendation. Replace with the work you choose.
